outcome: adverse composite maternal and perinatal outcome
cohort: The study included women with otherwise low-risk term pregnancies who underwent a trial of labor after a caesarean section (TOLAC), compared to a control group of women with no previous caesarean section.
finding: Trial of labor after caesarean section in low-risk pregnancies is associated with a higher rate of adverse composite maternal and perinatal complications compared to women with no previous caesarean section.
mod_finding: The increased risk of complications in TOLAC was primarily observed in women without a previous vaginal delivery, with higher rates of subsequent caesarean section and vaginal operative delivery in the previous caesarean section group.
